jobs.prompt: A clean, professional infographic diagram on a very light warm orange tinted background, subtle peachy tone. Flat design, modern tech style. Title at top center in bold dark sans-serif text: 'From Code to Live Website in 3 Steps'. The diagram shows a simple horizontal left-to-right flow with three large steps connected by thick arrow lines. STEP 1 on the left: A laptop icon with code brackets on screen, labeled 'Your Vibe-Coded Project' at top. A thick arrow points right to a large rounded rectangle with the GitHub octocat logo and text 'GitHub.com'. Below it a friendly subtitle in smaller text: 'Free cloud storage for your code — like Google Drive for apps'. STEP 2 in the middle: From GitHub, a thick arrow points right labeled 'One-Click Deploy' to a large rounded rectangle with the Vercel triangle logo and text 'Vercel'. Below it text: 'Your app is now live!' and a browser mockup showing URL 'yourproject.vercel.app'. STEP 3 on the right: From Vercel, a thick arrow points right labeled 'Connect Domain' to a large rounded rectangle showing a globe icon and text 'yourdomain.com'. Below it a small celebration icon and text 'Done! Your project is public.' The three steps have large circled numbers 1, 2, 3 above them. The flow is perfectly horizontal and clean. Top-left corner and top-right corner are completely empty with just the consistent light background. Flat vector infographic style, no photorealism, no 3D, clean geometric shapes, generous whitespace, thin consistent lines, very readable text.

A clean, minimal infographic diagram with very subtle light warm orange wash background. Modern flat design. Title at top center in clean dark sans-serif font: 'Ship Your Project in 3 Steps'. The diagram uses a vertical flow going top to bottom with three clearly separated rows. ROW 1 at top: On the left a laptop icon with code on screen and label 'Your App'. A long horizontal arrow with label 'git push' points to a large GitHub logo mark with text 'GitHub' next to it. On the right side of this row, a small callout bubble says 'Think of it as Dropbox for code — free'. ROW 2 in middle: From the GitHub element, a vertical arrow points down with label 'One Click' to a Vercel triangle logo with text 'Vercel' next to it. On the right, a small browser window mockup shows the URL bar with 'myproject.vercel.app' and a green dot indicating live. Label: 'Instantly live on the web'. ROW 3 at bottom: From Vercel, a vertical arrow points down with label 'Connect' to a globe icon with a custom domain 'yourdomain.com' in bold. A small checkmark icon and label 'You are live on your own domain'. Each row has a large step number on the far left: Step 1, Step 2, Step 3 in orange circles. Top-left corner and top-right corner are completely empty with just consistent background. Pure flat vector infographic, no photorealism, no gradients, clean geometric shapes, generous whitespace, very simple and easy to understand at a glance.
